articles.title: Healthcare Ads Are Coming To ChatGPT
articles.summary:
As AI discoverability becomes a priority for more medical providers, WebMD Ignite's new offering will help them launch ads in ChatGPT. 
The post Healthcare Ads Are Coming To ChatGPT appeared first on AdExchanger.

articles.title: Why brands are writing no-AI clauses into creator deals
articles.summary: While creators are welcoming brands’ no-AI demands, both sides need to agree upfront on whether creators are prohibited from using AI tools in any part of their process, according to Pearpop’s Kurt Stadelman.

articles.title: In all-hands meeting, Jensen Huang thanks White House and says he’s in therapy
articles.summary: The Nvidia founder apologized to his staff on Tuesday and said he was grateful for a second chance to lead the company.
